title: Georgia P NDE 6332
content:
I was pregnant with my first child; from my fourth month on I kept having problems. I was pretty much on bed rest. During my seventh month, I was resting in bed, when I sensed that something was very wrong. As I stood up, a lot of blood gushed out of me. My husband took me right to the hospital. I was only half-conscious and not coherent at the time. I was taken into the operating room, where I died. My mind became clear, and I found myself going into a very dark tunnel. I was one of the bright stars shining in that darkness. I had no body: I was floating in darkness. I heard a male voice telling me I needed to make some changes in my life, and for that reason, it wasn't time for me. My mind was like a fast elevator reviewing a whole lot of different aspects of my life. It was going faster and faster as I tried to figure out what changes that I needed to make. He told me that the next time I arrive there, when I see a bright tunnel, I will know I have fulfilled my life by making these changes. Before I was sucked back into my body, he made sure to remind me of this again. As I arrived back, I could hear people around me saying, 'She is going to be okay! She is back!' I did lose my child, but I know I will see him again. Q

environment.environment_other_detail: Very dark tunnel/darkness; experiencer described being 'one of the bright stars shining in that darkness.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Described as being 'sucked back into my body.'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told by a male voice that she needed to make changes in her life; said that next time she arrives there and sees a bright tunnel she will know she has fulfilled her life by making these changes.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Pregnancy hemorrhage in seventh month; taken to operating room.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Began with dark tunnel; then heard a male voice and had a rapid life review; then was told it was not time and was 'sucked back' into the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described self as 'one of the bright stars shining in that darkness.' Voice said that next time she arrives and sees a 'bright tunnel' she will know she has fulfilled her life by making the required changes.

She is back!”
